svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut one 95 mm length of 25 x 25 x 1.5 tube; the ends must be square,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: since they butt against the inside faces of the rails.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 6.5 mm holes front to back through both walls, on the centre

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: line of the side face, at 12.5, 37.5, 57.5 and 82.5 mm from one end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The outer two take the corner clips, the inner two the chain bracket.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: between the rails, 400 mm behind the drive axle (480 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front end of the rails), held by two corner clips on its rear face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it fits between the rails with no gap and no forcing.
